title: Sign must read exactly; regenerate or overlay if it does not
vague: a shopfront video for my bakery with the name on the sign
full: An 8-second square silent clip of a small bakery shopfront at morning, the sign above the door reading exactly 'Flour & Fable'; the name must be legible and correct in the final clip.
note: ours reads the frames and overlays the name if the sign is wrong; the MCP delivers whatever rendered
